{{Quote|Isn't it the sort of stuff that would bring the boys in blue crashing in here and blowing our op?|[[Sev/Legends|Sev]]|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>}}
'''Boys in Blue''' was a slang term used to refer to [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] with both the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]].
